title: Encoding of cerebellar dentate neuron activity during visual attention in rhesus macaques
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Predict individual dentate-neuron spike counts from trial events and category-dependent event responses; retain the original encoding problem. Behavioral decoding and modulation summaries are distinct source analyses, not interchangeable scalar victory targets.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Predict individual dentate-neuron spike counts from trial events and category-dependent event responses; retain the original encoding problem. Behavioral decoding and modulation summaries are distinct source analyses, not interchangeable scalar victory targets.

Source-paper comparison for Original held-out Poisson predictive likelihood; exact source reduction unresolved: Recover the original evaluated predictive likelihood and its normalization from cv2NegLnL. No published scalar on that exact support was recovered. Figure 3 modulation strength and Figure 4 significant-cell fraction are not predictive-accuracy objectives.
success_criteria: Recover a quantitative author performance baseline on the exact source DN cohort, trial exclusions, information conditions and CV outputs.
Calibrate the author implementation before testing a candidate; reproducing modulation figures is only calibration.
Compare candidate and author predictions on identical source folds and metric support, with a justified effect and dependence-aware uncertainty rule fixed before final scoring.
Do not count stronger p-values, more modulated cells, retrospective-versus-online changes, added inputs or the prospective blocked-fold conditional endpoint as surpassing the source paper.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: Dryad340611 cells4.2.mat.zip holds units/trials/spikes/events/eye data from2macaques; convertToGLMData explicitly converts spike times to ms and bundled neuroGLM/matRegress serve the author fits.
lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

versions_and_loader_contract.input_code_bridge: Dryad cells4.2.mat.zip is a trial/unit-level release with spikes, events and eye movements from two macaques. convertToGLMData maps these data into an experiment design, explicitly converting spike times to milliseconds; fitSingleCellGLM and behavioral fits consume that design. neuroGLM/matRegress are bundled in the pinned tree.
versions_and_loader_contract.readiness_scope: Only the listed substantial empirical analyses are artifact-ready for an attempt. This is not whole-paper reproduction, environment qualification, or scientific validation.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.
